why: Fix round for the one fault the review of slice AS-no-runtime-typeof-1 found, in next/: six swaps had put Effect's Predicate inside functions Playwright runs in Chromium, where no module import exists. The original typeof code is back on exactly those six lines: next/apps/fabrika/e2e/first-window.visual.test.ts 135 and 167 (inside loseFirstAnswers, which context.addInitScript runs in the page), instance.visual.test.ts 137 and 246 and reload.visual.test.ts 85 and 158 (inside each driver's page.evaluate body). first-window and instance no longer use Predicate, so their import lines went back to the base version too, and both files are now the same as on bcad0080d; reload keeps Predicate for its two Node-side swaps at 216 and 388. The brief asked for a 0563 C ignore line above each of the six, and also that no ignore line raise an unused-directive error. Both cannot hold today: .oxlintrc.json sets reportUnusedDisableDirectives to error, and anti-slop/no-runtime-typeof is not on for next/apps/fabrika yet (this slice adds no lock line, and the folder still has 7 hits in pull request 1366's files), so all six ignore lines were reported as unused and blocked lint. They were removed, and the six lines are listed as left. The lock pull request that turns the rule on for next/apps/fabrika adds above each the line `// oxlint-disable-next-line anti-slop/no-runtime-typeof -- runs in the page through page.evaluate, where Effect is not loaded` (for the two first-window lines, `through context.addInitScript`), as decision 0563 C allows. A search of every page.evaluate, evaluateAll, addInitScript and waitForFunction body in the files of git diff bcad0080d..HEAD found no other swapped Predicate call running in the page: keepSockets and loseLink in tezgah-focus.visual.test.ts, blockKeyStore in first-window.visual.test.ts and the evaluate bodies in tezgah.test-support.ts hold none. Hits now: the rule forced to error in a scratch config outside the repo finds exactly the six lines above in the three files. Slice total: 320 met, 296 fixed (round one's 302, from 277 codemod and 25 hand edits, less these six put back by hand), 24 left (11 in the .github/ci .mjs scripts named in round one, the 6 page-side lines here, and 7 in pull request 1366's files), 7 of them waiting on 1366.
note: No law was written or changed and no plant ran: this round puts back code that runs in the page. Checks, before the commit: pnpm format changed nothing; pnpm lint (with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144) fails only on the zero lock's three asks for oxlint-plugins, next/packages/libfabrika/src/client and next/programs/tezgah, which the later lock pull request owes, with no unused-directive error; ratchet.ts exits 0; the typecheck of next/apps/fabrika (tsc --noEmit -p .) passes. Not run: the three .visual. files, which the step rules leave unrun when the brief does not name them; the proof that their page bodies hold no Predicate is a read: first-window and instance match base byte for byte, and reload's only Predicate uses are at lines 216 and 388, outside the driver. No plain test reads these files.
